title: SCIM connection credentials: add a Setup action for mint and revoke
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cytQjG9X1CrCgytUM5

Follow-up of #30958 (PR #30991, merged at 41dc3024).

## Why

#30991 shipped the two platform-admin routes `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/scim/mint-credential` and `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/scim/revoke-credential`, documented as curl calls in `authentication.mdx`. There is no way to reach them from the console. A platform administrator setting up SCIM provisioning still has to use the command line to get a bearer token.

## What

- A `type: api` action on the SCIM connection credential object that calls the mint route and shows the token once in a result dialog. The token is never stored or shown again.
- A revoke action on a credential row, calling the revoke route (it already answers 404 / 409).
- Platform-objects translations for both actions, and an AI exposure classification for each.
- Optional, from contract review 6689658194 (nit 4): the mint door's own audit row could carry `metadata.impersonatedBy`, so the row says who acted on an impersonation session. `/admin/create-user`'s row doesn't do this either today.

## Out of scope

Letting an organization administrator mint, which would widen who can mint. That is a maintainer decision and is not proposed here.
